name: validate_strategies
description: 驗證策略檔案的格式（STRATEGY_META + generate_signal）

creation_path.why: 策略格式錯誤會導致 simulator 和 signal_engine 載入失敗

steps.description: 掃描所有模組的 active 策略，檢查 STRATEGY_META 和 generate_signal
steps.command: cd {ARENA_ROOT} && for mod in contestants/*/active; do for f in $mod/strategy_*.py $mod/*_recovery_*.py; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; has_meta=$(grep -c 'STRATEGY_META' "$f" 2>/dev/null); has_func=$(grep -c 'def generate_signal' "$f" 2>/dev/null); if [ "$has_meta" -eq 0 ] || [ "$has_func" -eq 0 ]; then echo "INVALID: $f (meta=$has_meta, func=$has_func)"; fi; done; done | head -50
cd {ARENA_ROOT}/contestants && for mod in */; do count=$(ls -1 "$mod/active/"strategy_*.py "$mod/active/"*_recovery_*.py 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "$mod: $count 個策略"; done

steps.description: 檢查是否有危險 import（os, subprocess, requests）
steps.command: cd {ARENA_ROOT}/contestants && grep -rl 'import os\|import subprocess\|import requests\|import socket' --include='*.py' */active/ 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo '安全：無危險 import'
